factual_claims.source_evidence: Significant Events After Year-End (Note 36): 'AAC Clyde Space has received an order from OHB Sweden valued at EUR 76.3 M (approx. SEK 820 M) for the delivery of 20 microwave radiometers... Approximately half of the contract value is expected to be recognised by the time the first six instruments are delivered by the end of 2028... Order backlog increased to approximately SEK 1.1 billion as of end of March 2026 (mentioned in CEO Review).'

factual_claims.claim: No dividend was proposed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The Board of Directors proposes that no dividend will be paid and that the retained earnings of SEK 628,192,029 be carried forward.'
